scope: Selected local integration servers and their historical file-store call chain; not a repository-wide or deployed-system security assessment

observed_interfaces.persistence: No project/history/retrieve/download endpoint in this handler
observed_interfaces.identity: LoopbackHost/Origin checks, not authenticated project-owner authorization

observed_interfaces.persistence: Calls run_history; diagnostic historical interface exists, contrary to any broad claim that no storage interface exists
observed_interfaces.delivery: Export/download route invokes permanent-deny output_gate; not an artifact exporter
observed_interfaces.identity: No authenticated principal/owner parameter in these handlers; loopback bound server only

observed_interfaces.storage: BASE points to local evidence/requests UUID directories containing request.json, result.json, lifecycle.json
validation: Original request/decision consistency for completed historical records
limitations: No trusted principal/owner/project association in reviewed functions
UUID unguessability is not owner ACL
File consistency is not authenticity against an actor able to rewrite all files
No current-rule replay or qualified snapshot issuance
list_historylimit50 is a view limit, not retention policy

observed_interfaces.storage: Create a unique local UUID directory, write request/result/lifecycle and stderr
limitations: Observed filesystem writes are not proof of durable cloud storage, crash-atomic commit, backup, or retention guarantees
Parent run/candidate bindings are lineage, not owner authorization

observed_interfaces.behavior: Reads historical summaries; explicit copy-request/repair action separate; no automatic live model or authority restoration

minimum_contract_needed.interface: Trusted authentication adapter yields principal. Server authorizes principal against owner/project before list/read/write/retrieve; never trust owner_id in raw W/L/n or a UUID.

Project stores immutable snapshot ID and owner association, original input/version, derived programme and capacity profile, model/rule/source/report/decision digests, provenance, status and artifact metadata. New revision is a new snapshot, not overwrite of approved content.

Provider-neutral put-if-absent/commit and owner-scoped metadata/blob retrieval with byte digests and bounded sizes; atomic commit or incomplete-state semantics, integrity failures explicit. Backend not selected or provisioned.

Retrieve exact saved artifact bytes under the same snapshot; no solver invocation. Diagnostic evidence and qualified deliverables must remain distinct. Positive qualified issuance depends on actual qualification.
Explicit retention policy and authorized recoverable/permanent deletion semantics, artifact expiry visibility and no fabricated durability promise. No deletion or settings changed in this task.
Cross-owner access, forged project/snapshot, stale/tampered hashes, incomplete commit, changed rule/input identity, unknown authority and accidental regeneration tests; not executed.
Owner-scoped idempotency tokens and retry semantics cannot overwrite a snapshot or leak another owner's metadata; list/project lookup have the same authorization boundary as blob retrieval.

reusable_without_claiming_product: UUID format/path guards and historical status taxonomy
Default-deny export boundary and distinction between history and current authority
blockers: Trusted authentication principal/owner model not identified in reviewed chain
Durable project storage provider and deployed adapter not selected
Actions start blocked by billing/spending-limit annotation
next_action: Choose and bind actual auth/storage interfaces under separately authorized scope before implementation; do not expose diagnostic local history as product persistence or reuse loopback/UUID as owner ACL.

rules: Never assign an old UUID directory to an arbitrary authenticated user or infer ownership from loopback/Host
Historical-only records remain historical; no silent conversion to current-source acceptance
Existing acceptedtrue records are rejected by history checker; preserve this default-deny boundary
Evidence storage namespace remains separate from user project snapshots
Owner/principal/project identifiers are outside rawW/L/n; backend locator is server-resolved, never an arbitrary caller filesystem path
Rejected/UNKNOWN/evaluator-error/partial snapshot statuses must be persisted without turning them into downloadable designs

review: Independent conceptual review plus parent source readback confirmed historical consistency vs product ownership distinction; no runtime security test or deployment inspection performed.
